lines.plainText: Know you how much the people may be mov'd

lines.text: By that which he will utter?
lines.plainText: By that which he will utter

lines.text: [Aside to Cassius.] By your pardon:
lines.plainText: Aside to Cassius By your pardon

lines.text: I will myself into the pulpit first,
lines.plainText: I will myself into the pulpit first

lines.text: And show the reason of our Caesar's death.
lines.plainText: And show the reason of our Caesar's death

lines.text: What Antony shall speak, I will protest
lines.plainText: What Antony shall speak I will protest

lines.text: He speaks by leave and by permission;
lines.plainText: He speaks by leave and by permission

lines.text: And that we are contented Caesar shall
lines.plainText: And that we are contented Caesar shall

lines.text: Have all true rights and lawful ceremonies.
lines.plainText: Have all true rights and lawful ceremonies

lines.text: It shall advantage more than do us wrong.
lines.plainText: It shall advantage more than do us wrong

lines.text: [Aside to Brutus.] I know not what may fall; I like it not.
lines.plainText: Aside to Brutus I know not what may fall I like it not

lines.text: Mark Antony, here, take you Caesar's body.
lines.plainText: Mark Antony here take you Caesar's body

lines.text: You shall not in your funeral speech blame us,
lines.plainText: You shall not in your funeral speech blame us

lines.text: But speak all good you can devise of Caesar,
lines.plainText: But speak all good you can devise of Caesar

lines.text: And say you do't by our permission;
lines.plainText: And say you do't by our permission

lines.text: Else shall you not have any hand at all
lines.plainText: Else shall you not have any hand at all

lines.text: About his funeral. And you shall speak
lines.plainText: About his funeral And you shall speak

lines.text: In the same pulpit whereto I am going,
lines.plainText: In the same pulpit whereto I am going

lines.text: After my speech is ended.
lines.plainText: After my speech is ended

lines.text: Be it so;
lines.plainText: Be it so

lines.text: I do desire no more.
lines.plainText: I do desire no more

lines.text: Prepare the body, then, and follow us.
lines.plainText: Prepare the body then and follow us

lines.text: O, pardon me, thou bleeding piece of earth,
lines.plainText: O pardon me thou bleeding piece of earth

lines.text: That I am meek and gentle with these butchers.
lines.plainText: That I am meek and gentle with these butchers

lines.text: Thou art the ruins of the noblest man
lines.plainText: Thou art the ruins of the noblest man

lines.text: That ever lived in the tide of times.
lines.plainText: That ever lived in the tide of times

lines.text: Woe to the hand that shed this costly blood!
lines.plainText: Woe to the hand that shed this costly blood

lines.text: Over thy wounds now do I prophesy,
lines.plainText: Over thy wounds now do I prophesy

lines.text: Which, like dumb mouths do ope their ruby lips
lines.plainText: Which like dumb mouths do ope their ruby lips

lines.text: To beg the voice and utterance of my tongue,
lines.plainText: To beg the voice and utterance of my tongue

lines.text: A curse shall light upon the limbs of men;
lines.plainText: A curse shall light upon the limbs of men

lines.text: Domestic fury and fierce civil strife
lines.plainText: Domestic fury and fierce civil strife

lines.text: Shall cumber all the parts of Italy;
lines.plainText: Shall cumber all the parts of Italy

lines.text: Blood and destruction shall be so in use,
lines.plainText: Blood and destruction shall be so in use

lines.text: And dreadful objects so familiar,
lines.plainText: And dreadful objects so familiar

lines.text: That mothers shall but smile when they behold
lines.plainText: That mothers shall but smile when they behold

lines.text: Their infants quartered with the hands of war;
lines.plainText: Their infants quartered with the hands of war

lines.text: All pity chok'd with custom of fell deeds:
lines.plainText: All pity chok'd with custom of fell deeds

lines.text: And Caesar's spirit, ranging for revenge,
lines.plainText: And Caesar's spirit ranging for revenge

lines.text: With Ate by his side come hot from Hell,
lines.plainText: With Ate by his side come hot from Hell

lines.text: Shall in these confines with a monarch's voice
lines.plainText: Shall in these confines with a monarch's voice

lines.text: Cry havoc and let slip the dogs of war,
lines.plainText: Cry havoc and let slip the dogs of war

lines.text: That this foul deed shall smell above the earth
lines.plainText: That this foul deed shall smell above the earth

lines.text: With carrion men, groaning for burial.
lines.plainText: With carrion men groaning for burial

lines.text: I do, Mark Antony.
lines.plainText: I do Mark Antony

lines.text: Caesar did write for him to come to Rome.
lines.plainText: Caesar did write for him to come to Rome

lines.text: He did receive his letters, and is coming,
lines.plainText: He did receive his letters and is coming

lines.text: And bid me say to you by word of mouth,—
lines.plainText: And bid me say to you by word of mouth

lines.text: [Seeing the body.] O Caesar!
lines.plainText: Seeing the body O Caesar

lines.text: Thy heart is big, get thee apart and weep.
lines.plainText: Thy heart is big get thee apart and weep

lines.text: Passion, I see, is catching; for mine eyes,
lines.plainText: Passion I see is catching for mine eyes

lines.text: Seeing those beads of sorrow stand in thine,
lines.plainText: Seeing those beads of sorrow stand in thine

lines.text: Began to water. Is thy master coming?
lines.plainText: Began to water Is thy master coming

lines.text: He lies tonight within seven leagues of Rome.
lines.plainText: He lies tonight within seven leagues of Rome

lines.text: Post back with speed, and tell him what hath chanc'd.
lines.plainText: Post back with speed and tell him what hath chanc'd

lines.text: Here is a mourning Rome, a dangerous Rome,
lines.plainText: Here is a mourning Rome a dangerous Rome

lines.text: No Rome of safety for Octavius yet.
lines.plainText: No Rome of safety for Octavius yet

lines.text: Hie hence, and tell him so. Yet stay awhile;
lines.plainText: Hie hence and tell him so Yet stay awhile

lines.text: Thou shalt not back till I have borne this corse
lines.plainText: Thou shalt not back till I have borne this corse

lines.text: Into the market-place: there shall I try,
lines.plainText: Into the marketplace there shall I try

lines.text: In my oration, how the people take
lines.plainText: In my oration how the people take

lines.text: The cruel issue of these bloody men;
lines.plainText: The cruel issue of these bloody men

lines.text: According to the which thou shalt discourse
lines.plainText: According to the which thou shalt discourse

lines.text: To young Octavius of the state of things.
lines.plainText: To young Octavius of the state of things

lines.text: Lend me your hand.
lines.plainText: Lend me your hand
